title: A look at the alternatives: Podman, containerd and LXC

videos.script: Docker is one tool among several, and they all run the same images. This last lesson looks at the others. {{under}} First, what Docker itself is made of: containerd, a small shim per container, and runc. Kubernetes uses the same parts. {{podman}} Then Podman. No daemon, and no root: inside the container the process is root, and on the host it is Ana. It also refuses to guess which registry a short name means. {{lxc}} And LXC, which runs a whole system in a container instead of one program. The image the course built runs on all but that last one, unchanged.
